about.description: Perpetual market on trade[XYZ] referencing the price of DRAM (dynamic random-access memory), the foundational semiconductor memory commodity used across PCs, servers, smartphones, and AI infrastructure, with pricing referencing a DRAM contract/spot benchmark. Positions are linear, margined and cash-settled in USDC on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
